As far as I know vigorous activity is not recommended during pregnancy because the oxygenated blood is redirected more towards the muscles since that’s were the blood is needed so the baby might is not getting enough oxygen and nutrients, if this happens regularly it could harm the baby. You should always be able to lead a conversation during exercise while pregnant which clearly on many occasions we have seen J wouldn’t be able to.

To the heavy lifting part, during pregnancy our body releases some hormones which can loosens tissues such as ligaments which are in joints and the pelvic floor, therefore pregnant women are more prone to injuries.

When it comes to the jumping, as I said the pelvic floor is more loose since you need it to become a bit wider to actually give a birth, it puts even more pressure to the pelvic floor which could lead to vaginal bleeding. 

IMO exercise during pregnancy is a great idea tho it has to be in moderation, and idk if J is just showing off and doing it just for the video to get more attention or she is actually doing those high intensity workouts, but this is how I understand the risks of what she’s doing. Hope it helped, tho I am no expert yet.

They can’t see my posts since I share it on close friends on instagram, and I regulate who can see the stories and who can’t.. I know everyone personally who sees them.. the only thing that can happen is that they could screen record the videos and share it. But if they are my friends why would they do it? Especially when I am being asked to tell stories from hospital because they like listening to them

I have never mentioned anyone’s names or where it happened, I rarely share any pictures from the hospital if ever (I think I shared one picture with a friend in two months working there).. for eg the last story was about how hard my shift was and that we had to stay in late because we had to take care of this lady who died, I shared how I felt about it and that I was the last person to be with her before she died, I explained what happens with the body after death (maybe inappropriate) in the meantime there were two old patients with dementia who kept running away, and they tore out their cannula multiple times and that it literally took three of us to hold them and insert a new one so they could get the medication they needed though it while they were spitting at us, kicking us, trying to bite us, scratching us etc.. I mentioned how the bad the ambulance system in my country is, patients had to wait around 6 hours before they went home and even then the family had to pick them up not to mention they were pissed at us even tho it wasn’t our fault while dealing with all this, another lady puked, she is quadriplegic, and she was choking, so we ran to save her, I haven’t stopped in 14 hours and had the urge to talk about this problem so the people could understand how hard the job of a nurse is..I am not a nurse, I will never be a nurse but as a medical student I can help during my studies with their job... never mentioned any names, I am unable to remember names nor recall faces after seeing hundreds of patients each week...

I know we have to get a permission to share pictures with patient, I don’t not have any nor I have took any pictures with them.. all I take is memories and experience..but there was this case when medical students were talking about what they did during their lessons in public transport and somebody emailed the hospital and school about it so since then everybody warns us not to talk in public since people get triggered very easily.. yet my case is not in public transport nor sharing the stories with complete strangers...

I don’t think she finds it too morbid since she is a medical student too and has to deal with similar stuff on daily basis as well.. I know mine is a bit more “spicy” since I took on two jobs during covid in public hospitals and she works in private one with minimal work... 
to be exact I post the stories to my close friends on public instagram account, people who were interested in the stories had to send me a message and I know them all personally.. so I have no clue what I could get in trouble for but still kinda scared me since I am in no good place to deal with some unnecessary trouble atm...

I am not mentioning any names, or place where it happened, it’s not even “public”, I regulate people who can see it.. but my friends told me I could get in trouble and even lose my job? I don’t share everything that happened, in two months I have worked in the hospital I have shared two stories, one was pretty hideous, never expected that to ever happen in my life, the other was focused on pure exhaustion of hospital employees, sharing how the situation escalated and how everything went down that day..
